evidence.observation: Held within about 1 °C of the 750 °C setpoint after a brief 759.7 °C overshoot at the start of growth (t=2520).
Settled to 37–45% at the hold, down from 80% at the end of the ramp. This fits the controller recovering from the overshoot.
Argon steady at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint.

args.missing_evidence: This furnace has no pressure gauge or exhaust O2 sensor, so a seal leak or exhaust blockage would not show up in telemetry. No ref distributions were provided, so heater power can't be checked against normal runs. Characterization after the run is needed to judge growth.
